navmesh.scope: Geometric NAVM triangle presence; no Skyrim pathfinding or reachability test.

body.scope: Fixed operator capsule against visual triangles and written Havok; intentional foot-floor contact excluded. Margins capped at64u are conservative lower bounds.

route.tested: Spawn/standing volume and NAVM support only; no route to the tower or live-engine path test.

angular_certificate.scope: Static REST angular samples only. Fire/Reset keyframe envelope, between-sample continuous motion, animations of surrounding world objects and Skyrim engine behavior were not measured.

existing_patrol_marker.scope: Marker retained; a negative margin means its old destination overlaps the new gun. No engine path guarantee.

patrol_marker_adjustment.scope: Measured destination support and standing capsule only; original rotation preserved, no Skyrim pathfinding test.
